headline: JetBlue Stock Surges Over 20% on New Target for Return to Profitability
summary: JetBlue Airways shares jumped more than 20% after the airline set a new profit target, easing investor concerns over its financial viability following years of losses.
why: JetBlue Airways is a major American low-cost carrier navigating cost inflation and fleet restructuring.

impacts.name: JetBlue Airways Corporation
impacts.why: Clear profit targets restored investor confidence in the airline's earnings outlook.

why_moved: The stock spiked after management presented a clear financial roadmap and achievable margin targets to restore multi-year operational profitability.
